scope: New authored bounded performance/controlled-change study for two fixed typed questions. No natural-language interpretation, external business truth or general RDF engine claim. Existing industrial24scene results immutable.

matrix.ordering: Repeat outermost, manifest case order, arm order rotated by(case_index+repeat)%3. No data-dependent order. Not random performance trials.
matrix.independent_unit: 22 authored graph cases; three process repetitions are technical repeats. Seeds relabel identities/row order, not independent business samples.

graph_generation.topology: One root target. For depth1 root connects directly to three products X/E/F. Otherwise depth-1 internal layers each of width b; root connects to all layer1; complete bipartite edges between consecutive internal layers; last internal layer connects to each X/E/F. Fourth product U has no incoming edge. X requires current cert in scope, E explicitly exempt, F different facility.
graph_generation.unrelated: Exactly total_edges-reachable_edges disconnected one-edge pairs in separate namespace, none joins target/products. Thus row-count size factor is unrelated edge load at fixed topology, NOT growth of target component; report both.
graph_generation.identity: Deterministic seeded permutation and row shuffle with local random.Random(seed); stable occurrence IDs assigned before shuffle. Lexicographic paths use occurrence IDs. Save full inputs/hashes before runs.
graph_generation.graph_count: All initial edges active, unique; graph-completeness declaration true. Dataset generator independently checks declared counts before freeze.
graph_generation.depth_interpretation: Depth1 changes layer width compared with depth3: combined simple-vs-multihop topology contrast, not pure depth effect. Depth3 vs6 atwidth3 isolates depth within this topology family. Branching experiment at256edges/depth3 useswidth1,3,8; width denotes layer size, not uniform outdegree. All topology/resource extrapolations limited to this family.

semantics.policy: Authored receipt/recheck policy from industrial-questions, restricted new performance domain; frozen old protocol not edited.
semantics.typed_questions: Receipt ID and target item/revision/certificate/as_of supplied explicitly. No LLM.
semantics.domain: Nonempty exact strings, strict ISO date-only parsed to ordinal, quantities are integer units Nos with abs(value)<=2^31-1; bool/float/nonintegral quantity rejected as unknown. This integer-only performance scope is narrower than prior Decimal baseline and must be stated.
semantics.reference_resolution: Exact ID, 0 matches missing, >1 ambiguous, exactly1 resolved. Unresolved any of3receipt references => receipt unknown and no content checks.
receipt_checks: inspection status Accepted true/Rejected false/other unknown
certificate status Active true/Inactive false/other unknown
semantics.aggregation: Any known false ->violation, else any unknown ->unknown, else accept. Unresolved-reference labels reported separately. All known checks evaluated, not shortcircuit.
semantics.reachability: Positive paths in active valid graph, target itself excluded even on cycles. Malformed/duplicate edge IDs excluded and complete=false. Missing path =>no only when exactlyonecomplete=True and no excludededges, otherwiseunknown. No OWL negative entailment claim.
semantics.recheck: Shared existing recheck ordering: noncandidate no->not_required /unknown->unknown; missing unique cert->unknown; explicit product exemption or known scope mismatch->not_required; missing requirement/scope->unknown; invalid date/interval/unrecognized status->unknown; expired recognized Active/Inactive->required; validcurrentActive->not_required;elseunknown.
semantics.witness: Shortest edge-occurrence sequence; ties lexicographically smallest sequence. Sorted adjacency BFS common across arms, charged to witness phase. OWL/SQL reachability membership must equal witness existence or execution_error; never substitute witness result for engine.
semantics.missing_evidence: Source-absent and projection-omitted cases held separately in correctness fixture lineage; same unavailable runtime facts may yield same unknown. No hidden-omission detection claim.

outputs.service_level: Primary comparison FULL service only: same receipt/links/product candidates/recheck/edge-witnesses plus exact per-check violated/unknown labels and supporting occurrence IDs/rule IDs. Engine-specific diagnostic counters may be separate non-scored metadata. No decision-only latency comparison claimed.
outputs.common_work: Strict parsing, duplicate detection, edge eligibility, completeness, witness extraction and recheck shared. Common normalization supplies values and unknown markers, never precomputed pass/fail to independent rule engines.

arm_map.python_indexed: Build exact ID indexes/adjacency; read frozen JSON rule configuration; evaluate receipt comparisons in Python; BFS establishes candidate membership.
arm_map.sqlite_recursive: SQLite :memory: tables + indexes on record IDs and component keys. SQL predicates evaluate known receipt values; recursive CTE UNION deduplicated node reachability terminates on cycles. No Python reachability UDF, no runtime expected answers. Common witness separately.
arm_map.rdf_owl_shacl: RDFLib triples +OWL-RL transitive closure computed in preparation; pySHACL actual known-value checks, reusable parsed shapes; RDF triple membership establishes candidates. Dates/quantities normalized, not compliance booleans. Shape focus nodes map to same check IDs. No SPARQL arm claim unless explicitly separately introduced/reviewed.

outputs.parity: Independent scorer loads only saved outputs/frozen reference data after execution; no runtime imports in scorer. Canonical sorted output; witness and diagnostics agreement required alongside decisions.

baseline_fixture.receipt: quantity5 remaining10, Accepted inspection, matching part/revision/facility, received2026-09-15
baseline_fixture.expected: accept; X,E,F candidateyes,U candidateno; Xrequired, E/F/U not_required. Expected witness from independent scorer traversal, not runtime path function.

lifecycle.clock: perf_counter_ns monotonic; raw nanoseconds saved; no rounding before aggregation
lifecycle.cold: Parent elapsed process start to result arrival reported separately; includes interpreter/import/IPC. Worker import/setup timestamps separately. Fixed interpreter/env/versions/CPU/memory/host load recorded. No OS page-cache eviction: cold-process, not cold-disk.
lifecycle.prepare: Input JSON reading/parse and common normalization separately timed; per-arm structure/index/shape/closure preparation separately timed. All completed before warmup.
lifecycle.warmup: Exactly1 full bundle query timed and saved as warmup, excluded from steady batches but charged in total lifecycle. No adaptive warmups.
lifecycle.steady: Batch sizes1,10,100 in that order in same resident worker; every iteration recomputes full answer, no final-answer memoization. Save each answer digest and first/full distinct output; do not time JSON disk writes as query. Batch cumulative CPU/cache effect disclosed.
lifecycle.update_E: Starting baseline, deactivate ALL edges whose parent is productX; mutation counts1atdepth1 orwidthotherwise. Common normalized change plus arm application/refresh timed as update. SQLtransaction and index maintenance, Pythonadjacency change, RDFasserted rebuild+freshclosure removing stale derived triples; no incremental algorithm claim for RDF. Query full bundle once after update separately timed/saved.
lifecycle.reset: Restore baseline by fresh arm construction between E and C, explicit reset duration saved but excluded from deployment update cost; no silent restored caches.
lifecycle.update_C: From restoredbaseline, set certificate expires2026-11-01. Apply+refresh then query full bundle. Implementation may reuse unaffected graph/closure but must record actual invalidation policy. E and C independent not cumulative.
lifecycle.expected_updates: E: Xcandidate no/rechecknot_required, other products unchanged, receiptaccept. C: candidates unchanged, all rechecknot_required, receiptaccept. No runtime use of expectations.
lifecycle.counts: Per completed worker1warmup+111steady+2postupdate=114bundles, plus baseline reset construction;198workers maximum22572bundle evaluations. Internal shared helper calls not independent observations.

resources.memory_measure: Success worker resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss (LinuxKiB) total-process highwater includes imports/allphases; not heap-only/not subtraction of peaks. Parent /proc status VmHWM samples for failures labeled observed lower bound, not exact successful RSS equivalent. RLIMIT_AS is virtual address-space cap, NOT RSS cap.
resources.termination: Isolated local algorithm child process new session, parent monotonic deadline, SIGTERM processgroup then SIGKILL after0.5s; no LLM workers. Explicit MemoryError labeledmemory_limit; other signals not automatically calledOOM.
resources.stop: Before each worker enforce remaining campaign/deadline/artifact budget. On any worker timeout/MemoryError retain failure and continue manifest (no rerun); no larger unplanned tiers. Global cap leaves all remaining slots not_run with reason, including gaps in denominators.198*(12+0.5)=2475s maxworkerwait;2700s ceiling includesparent overhead.
resources.pretests: Fresh-reviewed disposable sleep/memory-failure workers verify termination/logging before study; no external service/infrastructure. These are software tests, not benchmark samples.

analysis.accuracy: Every scheduled198slot retained; label not_run,timeout,memory_limit,execution_error,schema_error,semantic_mismatch,success separately. Correctness checks on outputs for baseline/warmup/steady/updates; distinct failed iterations cannot be hidden by final batch success.
analysis.cost: Compare timings only for fully semantically matched worker phases; report exclusions and all failure rates next to timings. No failed result repaired/reclassified as success.
analysis.statistics: Per case+arm median/min/max of3technical repeats. Paired ratios bycase, report all22cases; no population p-value or inference from repeated timings.2seed identity/row-order variants are sensitivity not independent domain replications.
analysis.break_even: For correct paired cases use measured preparation +warm query batchtotal and update scenarios; report measured1/10/100 bundle totals. A linear amortization estimate uses explicit Tprep+n*Tquery assumption and is labeled modeled, never measured crossover. If no observed signchange, report no observed crossover.
analysis.memory: Report wholeworkerpeak not phase-memory attribution. Captured timeout lowerbounds incomparable to successRSS as exact estimates.
analysis.choice_table: Workload/topology+outputservice+hardware+implementation+metric. Conditional conclusions only. This is unrelated-load/depth/width study, not broad real-domain threshold.

maintenance.design: 5tasks x3arms=15 initial controlled submissions. Isolated frozen baseline copies per task, no cumulative edits. Baseline hashes/config/adapter sources frozen after correctness checks, before task implementation. Each submitted patch hash recorded before checks. Up to1corrective submission per task-arm, both saved; failed first attempt remains first failure. This is development intervention not held-out accuracy. Runtime never reads acceptance expected values.

maintenance.baseline_checks: Preserve existing unmodified task fixtures, all tasks run baseline regression bundle plus declared task cases. Freeze concrete case JSON +literal expected outputs before edits; independent review beforechecks.

Shared helper countedonceglobally and referenced in each affectedarm, not triplecounted. No LOC equals human difficulty inference.
maintenance.effort: Agent wall time/familiarity/order recorded ifavailable; not humanmaintenance effort. Declare this limit while still reporting measured operational refresh and concrete change scope.

freeze_and_gates: This protocol review does not certify implementation. Build manifests/fixtures/references +adapters/runner/scorer next, then fresh independent review before registered softwarechecks or study. No original pilots/heldout/ledgers changed. Changes to protocol require versioned preserved draft and newreview.
